properties.name: Bell County East to Big Hill
properties.status: Route case filed March 26, 2026 with 122 route options. In August the state judges (SOAH) recommended denying it: need not shown, and about 1,400 landowners may not have been properly notified. On Sept. 11 the PUC sent it back to the judges for a supplemental recommendation on two points, so the decision is delayed and no route is chosen yet.
properties.note: Straight line between end substations, NOT the route
